entities.name: Emmanuel Rodríguez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Emmanuel Rodríguez Vázquez is a Puerto Rican professional boxer who has held the International Boxing Federation (IBF) bantamweight title twice between 2018 and 2024. As an amateur he represented Puerto Rico at the 2010 Summer Youth Olympics and won a gold medal in the flyweight event.
